Alluring Skills Bonus.notes: Grants multiple permanent skill bonuses of the same amount and bonus type to Bluff, Diplomacy, Haggle, Intimidate, and Perform.

Astute Skills Bonus.notes: Grants permanent Exceptional bonuses to Disable Device, Repair, and Search skills.

Blighted Lore.notes: Affix grants passive Equipment bonus to critical chance for multiple spell damage types; decomposed into matching Lore affixes for Acid, Negative, Poison, and Evil.

Blood.notes: Compound affix grants +20 Positive Healing Amplification (Enhancement) and -10% Fortification (Penalty). Both are permanent stat changes.

Charisma Skills.notes: Grants permanent Exceptional bonus to multiple Charisma-based skills, treated as compound because it affects multiple distinct skill stats.

Combat Mastery +12 Combat Mastery.notes: This affix provides a permanent enhancement bonus to the DCs of Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist as a single grouped affix.

Combat Mastery +4 Combat Mastery.notes: This affix provides a permanent +4 enhancement bonus to the DCs of multiple combat maneuvers and class features, thus it is decomposed into multiple permanent stat bonuses.

components.name: DC to resist Improved Trip attempts
DC to resist Improved Sunder attempts
DC to resist Stunning Blow attempts
DC to resist Stunning Fist attempts
Insight bonus on Charisma based skill checks

Command.notes: The Command affix grants a positive insight or competence bonus on Charisma-based skill checks and imposes a fixed -6 penalty on Hide checks. Both are permanent bonuses/penalties inherent to the item, so it is a compound affix.

Confounding Enchantment.notes: This affix grants one of several +1 Exceptional ability bonuses permanently (until unequipped) on each equip. Thus it is compound because it can grant multiple different permanent stat bonuses, but only one at a time.

Cooking By the Book.notes: This affix consists of multiple permanent bonuses across spell power, spell critical chance, imbue dice, and melee/ranged power. All bonuses are passive and permanent, making this a compound affix exposing multiple stat components.

Creeping Dust Lore.notes: Creeping Dust Lore grants a permanent Equipment bonus to critical hit chance for Cold and Acid spells, decomposed into separate Cold and Acid spell critical chance affixes.

Crown of Summer.notes: The affix 'Crown of Summer' grants permanent enhancement bonus to Positive Healing Amplification, Melee Power, and Ranged Power, all always on. Decomposed into underlying permanent stat bonuses.

Darkwood.notes: Darkwood grants two permanent underlying stat bonuses: +1 hardness and -2 armor check penalty.

Devil's Bones.notes: Decomposed +23% Enhancement bonus to Fire and Evil Absorption into separate components as permanent stat bonuses.

components.name: Insight bonus to Fortitude Saving Throws
Insight bonus to Reflex Saving Throws
Insight bonus to Will Saving Throws

Dragonshard Focus: Sentinel.notes: The affix 'Parrying I' provides fixed passive insight bonuses to AC and all saving throws, treated as permanent bonuses.

Dream Vision.notes: Grants scaled competence bonuses to both Attack and Damage rolls permanently; the bypass of miss chance vs. Incorporeal is a permanent property, not decomposed into stats.

Electricity and Acid Absorption.notes: This affix grants a permanent Enhancement bonus to both Electricity Absorption and Acid Absorption as detailed in the tooltip. Both components scale equally with the affix value, so it is appropriate to decompose this compound affix into two separate absorption bonuses.

Elemental Absorption.notes: Decomposed Elemental Absorption into Acid, Cold, Fire, Electrical, and Sonic Absorption for permanent Enhancement bonus absorption stats.

Elemental Manipulation.notes: Elemental Manipulation is a compound affix providing permanent +90 Equipment bonus to Acid, Cold, Electric, and Fire Spell Power.

Elemental Resistance.notes: Elemental Resistance is a compound affix that provides multiple permanent elemental resistances. Each resistance component inherits the affix's bonus value and bonus type from the parsed affix.

Elemental Resonance.notes: Elemental Resonance grants equal permanent Equipment Spell Power bonuses to Acid, Fire, Electric and Cold; decomposed into four components.

Epic Nimbleness.notes: Grants permanent increases to maximum Dexterity bonus and reduction to armor check penalty; both are permanent underlying stat modifications.

Eternal Faith.notes: The affix grants multiple permanent bonuses related to turning undead and thus is compound. All bonuses are fixed values.

Feeds Off Madness.notes: The affix grants passive, permanent bonuses to Spell Penetration and Spell Power as Equipment bonuses that stack with other sources and are always on. 'Feeds Off Madness' is a compound affix combining those permanent bonuses.

Fire and Cold Absorption.notes: This affix grants two permanent stat bonuses: Enhancement Bonus to Fire Absorption and Enhancement Bonus to Cold Absorption, each scaling with the parsed value.

Fire and Cold Absorption +22% Fire and C.notes: This affix grants Enhancement bonus absorption to both Fire and Cold damage types as permanent passive bonuses. Decomposed into two components for Fire Absorption and Cold Absorption respectively.

Fire and Cold Absorption +40% Fire and C.notes: Affix grants a permanent 40% enhancement bonus to both Fire Absorption and Cold Absorption; decomposed into two separate absorption components.

Force Spell Power.notes: This compound affix grants Equipment bonus to multiple spell damage types' Spell Power, each decomposed into separate permanent underlying components.

Ghostbane.notes: This affix grants a permanent weapon bonus: extra bane damage vs. Undead scaling with affix rank and a fixed Ghost Touch effect that bypasses ethereal monster evade chance. Both are passive and always active, so the affix is decomposed into permanent bonus components.

Good Luck.notes: Grants a Luck bonus to all saves and skill checks equal to the affix number.

Greater Nimbleness.notes: Grants two distinct permanent benefits: +2 to max Dex bonus and -4 armor check penalty.

Greater Stability.notes: Bonuses apply only for characters of True Neutral alignment but are permanent while the item is equipped.

Greater Water Elemental Form.notes: Permanent passive bonuses for Cold caster level, Cold spell power, and Cold spell critical damage as water elemental.

Ice Intensity.notes: Affix grants a permanent enhancement bonus to critical damage for Cold spells and is decomposed into related Spell Crit Damage affix component.

Illusory Death.notes: Illusory Death is a compound affix that increases caster level for illusion and necromancy spells by the same parsed amount.

Improved Heroism.notes: Improved Heroism grants a permanent +3 morale bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks, constituting multiple underlying stat bonuses.

Intelligence Skills.notes: Grants an Exceptional bonus to four Intelligence-based skills: Disable Device, Repair, Search, and Spellcraft, each scaling with affix value.

Kinetic Intensity +12% Kinetic Intensity.notes: This compound affix grants a permanent enhancement bonus to spell critical damage for both Force and Physical spells, decomposed into their respective affix components.

Kinetic Intensity +24% Kinetic Intensity.notes: Decomposed compound affix granting enhancement bonuses to critical damage for both Force and Physical spell types.

Knight's Loyalty.notes: Set bonus Knight's Loyalty grants permanent +3 artifact bonus to To-Hit and Damage rolls, and +3 insight bonus to natural armor when all three items equipped.

Legendary Armor-Piercing.notes: This affix provides a passive always-on percentage bonus to Fortification Bypass, which is a permanent stat affecting attacks ignoring enemy Fortification. It is correctly parsed as a compound affix with one component representing the underlying bonus.

Legendary Cooking By the Book.notes: This affix grants multiple permanent stat bonuses across multiple categories including spell power, critical chance, imbue dice, melee/ranged power, and spell critical damage. These are all passive and always-on bonuses derived from set bonuses (3 and 4 pieces equipped).

components.name: Competence Bonus to Positive and Repair Healing Amplification
Profane Bonus to Negative Healing Amplification

Lifeblood of the Undead Prince.notes: Compound affix granting multiple permanent bonuses to healing amplification with distinct bonus types; each scales with the affix magnitude.

Litany of the Dead - Ability Bonus.notes: Grants +1 Profane bonus to all Abilities (Str, Con, Dex, Int, Wis, Cha).

Litany of the Dead II - Ability Bonus.notes: Grants +2 Profane bonus to all Abilities, parsed value scales the bonus for each ability.

Litany of the Dead II - Combat Bonus.notes: Grants +4 Profane bonus to both attack bonus and damage as permanent bonuses.

components.name: Rust and Repair Spell Crit Chance
Rust and Repair Spell Crit Damage

Memory of Animated Objects.notes: Compound affix with multiple permanent underlying bonuses all to Rust and Repair spells: Spell Power, Spell Crit Chance, and Spell Crit Damage.

Mind Tear.notes: Mind Tear is a compound affix permanently reducing Magical Resistance and Spell Power of foes; underlying stat bonuses decomposed accordingly.

Negative Spell Power.notes: Decomposed combined Negative Spell Power passive bonus into its underlying components for Necrotic and Poison spell power.

Nimble Skills Bonus.notes: The Nimble Skills Bonus affix grants a permanent, always-on bonus to multiple skills (Balance, Hide, Move Silently, Open Lock, Tumble) with the specified bonus type and amount. It is compound because it represents multiple underlying skill bonuses that are always active.

Overfocus.notes: The affix grants two distinct permanent penalties (-10 to Search and -10 to Spot), making it compound.

Parrying.notes: Parrying grants multiple permanent Insight bonuses: to AC, and to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will saves. These are permanent and not conditional on combat states, so the affix is compound.

Permanent Nihil.notes: Decomposed Permanent Nihil into separate Alchemical bonuses to Negative and Poison Spell Power as permanent stat bonuses.

Power of Creeping Dust.notes: This affix grants a permanent Equipment bonus to both Cold Power and Acid Power equally, so it is compound with two underlying stat bonuses.

Power of the Blight.notes: This affix grants multiple permanent Equipment bonus spell power stats to Acid, Negative, Poison, and Evil damage types. It is decomposed into separate components to reflect these individual bonuses.

Power of the Firestorm.notes: The affix 'Power of the Firestorm' grants a permanent Equipment bonus to both Fire and Electric Spell Power. It is a compound affix exposing multiple permanent underlying stat bonuses as separate components.

Power of the Flames of Darkness.notes: This compound affix grants three permanent Equipment bonuses to Fire, Negative, and Poison Spell Power.

Power of the Frozen Storm.notes: This affix grants two permanent underlying stats: bonus to Cold Spell Power and bonus to Electric Spell Power, both scaling with the affix value.

Power of the Frozen Thunderstorm.notes: Decomposed compound affix granting +145 Equipment bonus to Cold, Sonic, and Electric Spell Power into matching individual Spell Power components.

Power of the Moonlit Haunt.notes: Affix compoundly grants Equipment bonus to Negative, Force, and Poison Spell Power equally, decomposed into three permanent stat bonuses.

Power of the Sacred Ground.notes: This affix grants +148 Equipment bonus to Acid, Light, and Alignment Spell Power as permanent bonuses.

Power of the Thunderstorm.notes: The affix grants permanent Equipment bonus to both Sonic and Electric Spell Power. Decomposed into two components for Sonic and Electric Spell Power respectively.

Protection from Evil.notes: Protection from Evil grants two permanent passive bonuses: a Deflection bonus to AC and a Resistance bonus to Saves vs Evil Monsters. Both scale with the affix number.

Prudent Skills Bonus.notes: Prudent Skills Bonus is a compound affix representing multiple permanent Exceptional bonuses to Heal, Listen, and Spot skills.

Radiance.notes: Radiance is a compound affix exposing permanent Equipment bonus to both Light and Alignment Spell Power.

Radiance Intensity +12% Radiance Intensi.notes: Decomposed Radiance Intensity into separate Spell Crit Damage affixes for Light and Alignment spells since the affix grants permanent bonuses to critical damage for multiple spell damage types.

Radiance Intensity +24% Radiance Intensi.notes: Decomposed Radiance Intensity +24% into Light Spell Crit Damage and Alignment Spell Crit Damage enhancement bonuses.

Reconstruction.notes: Reconstruction affix grants permanent Equipment/Insight/Quality bonus to both Repair and Rust Spell Power, representing two distinct underlying stat bonuses, thus it is compound.

Repair Intensity +12% Repair Intensity.notes: Decomposed the compound affix 'Repair Intensity +12% Repair Intensity' into its component permanent stat bonuses for critical damage enhancement on Repair and Rust spell damage types.

Repair Intensity +24% Repair Intensity.notes: Compound affix granting permanent +24% Enhancement bonus to critical damage with Repair and Rust spells decomposed into single Repair Intensity Spell Crit Damage affix.

Resistance.notes: This Resistance affix grants permanent bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will saving throws equally.

Resistance +1 Resistance.notes: Resistance +1 Resistance grants a +1 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will saving throws. Decomposed into separate Resistance components per save.

Resistance +10 Resistance.notes: Decomposed from '+10 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws' into three separate Resistance components.

Resistance +11 Resistance.notes: This affix grants a permanent +11 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws as a compound affix with three underlying resistance components.

Resistance +12 Resistance.notes: Decomposed the Resistance +12 affix into its three underlying permanent bonuses to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Resistance +3 Resistance.notes: This affix grants a Resistance bonus of +3 to all saving throws: Fortitude, Reflex, and Will. The value is parsed and split into three permanent resistance bonuses.

Resistance +4 Resistance.notes: This affix grants a permanent +4 Resistance bonus to all three saving throws: Fortitude, Reflex, and Will. Decomposed into three underlying Resistance affixes.

Resistance +5 Resistance.notes: Decomposed Resistance +5 affix into separate Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Resistance components, each with the same parsed value.

Resistance +6 Resistance.notes: Resistance +6 Resistance grants +6 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will saving throws, decomposed into separate components for each save type.

Riposte.notes: The Riposte affix grants a permanent Insight bonus to AC and all three saving throws. Damage dealt when missed by attack is a triggered effect and thus excluded.

Slice 'n Dice Set.notes: Set bonus provides two permanent Quality bonuses: +1 Seeker and +1 Sneak Attack while wearing both items.

Sonic Intensity.notes: This affix is a compound affix that grants an enhancement bonus to critical damage with Sonic spells. It is normalized as a Sonic Spell Crit Damage component with the enhancement bonus type.

Stability.notes: Permanent +2 Deflection bonus to AC and +2 Resistance bonus to saving throws for True Neutral alignment characters.

Stone Paws.notes: Stone Paws grants +2 Weapon Damage and DR 15/Adamantine while in Animal Form. These are permanent passive bonuses in that form, so decomposed into separate fixed bonuses.

Superior Stability.notes: Grants +6 deflection bonus to AC and +6 resistance bonus to saves for characters of True Neutral alignment; both permanent while the item is equipped and conditions met.

Voice of Deceit.notes: This affix grants multiple permanent competence bonuses to 4 different skills.

Well Rounded.notes: Grants a Profane bonus to all six ability scores; thus it is a compound affix with multiple permanent stat bonuses.
